risk_description:
Improper electric traction reducer may be installed due to a wrong reference in the repair instructions.
As a result,  the speedometer may indicate 45 km/h while the vehicle is driven with 80 km/h, increasing the risk of injury in the event of an accident.
legal_provision: The product does not meet the requirements laid down in the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
